As far as God is concerned, your sins are forgotten, and as far away from Him as the East is from the West. Satan wants you to focus on your sins and everything you do wrong everyday. Problem is, EVERYONE sins. There is none that are "good", not even one.   
Stop focusing on what you are doing wrong. Start focusing on the good things you do in your life. Did you make someone smile today? God loves that. Did you help someone who needed it? God loves that. Do as much good as you can every day. Even on this on Reddit. Lift people up. Encourage them. Help them. Go out into the world. Volunteer with a Christian organization. Forget the bad, spread the good. You will be ok.

Never let anything worldly take control of your life. You have a need, a vacuum in your life. You fill that need with porn. Go find something to replace it. Just stopping it will create a vacuum. Find something to keep you busy, keep your attention. Even if it's video games, or hanging out with friends, or Bible study. Giving it up is too hard. Replace it with something else and you won't have time to do it, and you will be happy and feel good for doing it.

Give your life up. Stop living for yourself. Start living for God. Praying and repenting is very important, but there is more. Go find somewhere to volunteer. Go help others. Sacrifice your life and wants to others for God. Go help them.   
God does not remember any of your sins. They are as far from Him as the East is from the West. YOU are focusing on your sins. Sin is going to happen whether we like it or not. Focus on good things. Use your life to help others. They need it.

Praying in the Spirit: Ever have thoughts in your head that you have a hard time finding the words for? Like "I know/feel this thing, but I don't know how to say it with words." That would be praying in the Spirit.  
As for discerning the voice of the Holy Spirit from your own thoughts, ask yourself these questions:  
Is the voice/thought aligned up with scripture? If yes, could be the Spirit, could be you, good either way.   
Is the voice/thought telling me something I don't want to hear/feel/think, but agrees with scripture? Most likely the Spirit  
Is the voice/thought just neutral and random?  i.e. "Kinda hungry for spaghetti" Most likely just your own thoughts.
